## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit and/or browser)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` → `## [Unreleased]` has an entry (skip for internal-only changes)
- [ ] Public API changed? `pnpm docs:api` run and the change documented (`pnpm docs:check` passes)
- [ ] Stored JSON format changed? Migration added and noted in `docs/migration.md`
- [ ] Visual change? Before / after screenshots attached
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
